name: Marshlands Nature Camp
description_short: County run nature day camp at Marshlands Conservancy in Rye for kids entering grades 1 to 6, who take weekly expeditions into the salt marsh, fields and woods to study insects, plants and mammals. Grades 7 to 9 have a separate three day outdoor survival skills session in August.

sessions.name: Eagles Outdoor Skills (grades 7 to 9, three days)

notes: Weekly rate for grades 1 to 6: $375 for Westchester County residents, $425 for non-residents. Eagles Outdoor Skills (grades 7 to 9): one three day session, August 11 to 13, $350 for residents and non-residents, supplies and take home gear included. Hours 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Campers may attend at most three weeks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. County nature camps page, 2026 season: registration for county residents opened first, non-residents from March 2026. Camp runs 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in one and two week sessions, Monday July 6 through Friday August 14; campers may attend three weeks at most. Ages are derived from grades (entering grades 1 to 9), not stated. Weekly price is the non-resident rate; county residents pay less (see notes). Marshlands groups: Falcons (grades 1 to 3) and Hawks (grades 4 to 6), five one week sessions July 6 to August 7, $375 resident, $425 non-resident; Eagles (grades 7 to 9) three days, August 11 to 13, $350 for all.
Researched by Claude from this page. Marshlands Conservancy page: directions give Route 1, Rye, NY 10580 (no street number).
